question_axes.question: Is cash generation durable through the commodity cycle?
Can management deliver production and capex guidance?
Is downstream demand consistent with the volume plan?
Can upstream capacity and projects come online as stated?
Has management historically delivered against production and return targets?

verification_seeds.title: Verify industry demand, customer capex, competition, and supply
verification_seeds.description: Check downstream demand, project capacity, and whether production plans are supported outside issuer commentary. Keep issuer claims and independent confirmation as separate evidence families.

verification_seeds.title: Measure earnings-window price reaction versus indexes and the sector ETF
verification_seeds.description: Compute event-window returns versus SPY, QQQ, and the sector ETF. Describe fundamentals-versus-price tension. Do not conclude that news is priced in.

verification_seeds.title: Seek counter-evidence and alternative explanations
verification_seeds.description: Attack demand, execution, customer concentration, margin, and valuation assumptions. Record opposing evidence and unresolved gaps.

valuation_framework.multiple_reason: energy producers are valued on cycle-normalized earnings and FCF rather than peak growth multiples
